data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **Affected workflows:** .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Every line of code that merges to main must pass an LLM code review. Each commit on a story/, bug-batch/, or fix/ branch should receive **exactly one** LLM review per CI cycle — no silent skips (bugs 1624-5fb9, da45-7d92 closed) and no duplicate work.

#### Actual Behavior

Two independent LLM-review pipelines run on every commit on story/, bug-batch/, fix/ branches with an open PR:

| Workflow | Trigger | Job (check name) | In required-checks.txt? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CI` (ci.yml) | pull_request to main | `llm-review` | yes |
| `Sprint Story Review` (per-branch-review.yml) | push to story/**, bug-batch/**, fix/** | `Per-Story LLM Review` | no |

Both jobs invoke the same `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh`. Both burn API tokens, both produce PR comments, both can produce conflicting verdicts (one pass / one fail) because LLM reviewers are nondeterministic.

Observed on PR #213 (current session):
- Per-Story LLM Review: PASS (no findings)
- llm-review: FAIL (1 important finding — false-positive type-mismatch claim)

The required check is `llm-review`, so the FP gates the PR even though Per-Story LLM Review passed. This structurally amplifies FP risk: two independent reviewer rolls → higher P(at-least-one-FP) than a single roll.

The duplication is also pre-bug-3914-0848-faad-4f6a vestigial. That bug broadened ci.yml's pull_request trigger to fire on PRs targeting any base branch (including session branches). Before that fix, story-branch PRs to session branches skipped ALL of ci.yml — per-branch-review.yml was the only review path. Now that ci.yml covers every PR base, per-branch-review.yml's push trigger is redundant.

### 3. Action History

* bug 1624-5fb9: silent-skip on direct PRs — closed (fail-open defaults added to ci.yml's `changes` job)
* bug da45-7d92: per-branch-review.yml never triggers on sprint commits — closed (sprint orchestrator now creates story/ branches)
* bug 3914-0848-faad-4f6a: ci.yml restricted to PRs targeting main — closed (broadened to any base)

Each fix correctly addressed its symptom but none consolidated the now-redundant per-branch-review.yml.

### 4. Proposed Fix (to be brainstormed)

**Option 1 (preferred — simplest)**: Delete per-branch-review.yml entirely. All review goes through ci.yml's `llm-review` on `pull_request`. Coverage guarantee: every merge goes through merge-to-main-pr.sh which requires the PR to exist, which fires ci.yml's pull_request trigger, which runs llm-review. Single review per commit. No silent skip because the required check is `llm-review` and it must complete.

Risks to verify:
- Does per-branch-review.yml provide ANY coverage that ci.yml does not? Both have the same job set (actionlint, shellcheck, lint-python, test-hooks, test-scripts, validate-required-checks, mirror-defenses-to-pr, llm-review). If any job in per-branch-review.yml has unique configuration (e.g., different gating, different timeout, different dispatch logic), preserve it in ci.yml before deletion.
- Do any branches reach merge WITHOUT a PR? Per merge.strategy=pr + Rule 23 (no direct gh pr merge / git push), no.
- Is there ANY workflow that fires on push to story/bug-batch/fix branches that ISN'T duplicated in ci.yml? If yes, those need a home (could be a separate non-review workflow).

**Option 2 (conservative — preserves push-time review)**: Add an `if:` skip to ci.yml's `llm-review` that fires when the head_ref matches story/**, bug-batch/**, fix/**, AND verifies that per-branch-review.yml has completed successfully on the same SHA. Falls back to running ci.yml's llm-review if the verification fails (no silent skip). More complex but preserves the "review on every push" semantic for sprint flows.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Affects: .github/workflows/ci.yml (llm-review job), .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml (entire workflow)
* Reader of required-checks.txt: plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh
* Verification: every merged PR over a 1-week sample should show exactly ONE llm-review run per SHA

### 6. Logs

Sample of duplicate runs on PR #213 cycle 1:
- Per-Story LLM Review: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26012083428/job/76455505768 (PASS)
- llm-review: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26012083428/job/76455592967 (FAIL)
data.title: [ci/llm-review]: ci.yml + per-branch-review.yml run duplicate LLM review on story/bug-batch/fix branches -> doubled compute, doubled FP exposure
